snippet.title: Drawmi: Twin Stick Announcement Trailer - Draw the Bad Guys and Survive the Arena
snippet.description:
Drawmi: Twin Stick is coming to Steam Next Fest in October!
Wishlist now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5126250/Drawmi_Twin_Stick/
And watch for playtests and the demo!

Drawmi is a new “draw it yourself” game franchise by Doonamai. Whether you, your friends, or your kids enjoy drawing, these games are built to express creativity and bring your drawings to life.

Drawmi: Twin Stick is a wild co-op game of the series. A fast, chaotic twin-stick arena shooter where you draw every enemy, weapon, player, and obstacle before the waves close in. Local and online co-op for up to 4 players.

Follow the entire Drawmi Series at: https://drawmigames.com
